const MAX_HISTORY_STACK = 50;
const PREDEFINED_COLORS = [
  '#000000', '#FFFFFF', '#FF0000', '#00FF00', '#0000FF', '#FFFF00',
  '#FF00FF', '#00FFFF', '#808080', '#A0522D', '#2E8B57', '#4682B4',
  '#D2B48C', '#ADD8E6', '#FFA07A', '#90EE90', '#E6E6FA', '#FFC0CB',
  '#F0E68C', '#DDA0DD', '#FA8072', '#7FFFD4'
];
const FONT_FAMILIES = ['Inter', 'Arial', 'Verdana', 'Times New Roman', 'Courier New', 'Georgia', 'Impact', 'Comic Sans MS'];
const TEXT_ALIGN_OPTIONS: Array<fabric.IText['textAlign']> = ['left', 'center', 'right', 'justify'];
type Tool = 'Select' | 'Pen' | 'Rectangle' | 'Ellipse' | 'Text' | 'Eraser' | 'Line' | 'Polygon' | 'Star';
type Tool = 'Select' | 'Pen' | 'Rectangle' | 'Ellipse' | 'Text' | 'Eraser' | 'Line' | 'Polyline' | 'Polygon' | 'Star';
// Fabric.js type aliases
type FabricCanvas = fabric.Canvas;
type FabricObject = fabric.Object & { id?: string; layerName?: string; brushType?: BrushType };
type FabricGroup = fabric.Group & { id?: string; layerName?: string };
type FabricIText = fabric.IText & { id?: string; layerName?: string };
type FabricLine = fabric.Line & { id?: string; layerName?: string };
type FabricPolyline = fabric.Polyline & { id?: string; layerName?: string };
// --- Zustand Store for Centralized State Management ---
interface DesignStudioState {
  fabricCanvas: FabricCanvas | null;
  setFabricCanvas: (canvas: FabricCanvas | null) => void;
  activeTool: Tool;
  setActiveTool: (tool: Tool) => void;
  artboardSize: { width: number; height: number };
  setArtboardSize: (size: { width: number; height: number }) => void;
  selectedObjects: FabricObject[];
  setSelectedObjects: (objects: FabricObject[]) => void;
  brushSettings: {
    color: string;
    width: number;
    type: BrushType;
    opacity: number;
  };
  setBrushSettings: (settings: Partial<DesignStudioState['brushSettings']>) => void;
  history: string[];
  historyIndex: number;
  addToHistory: (state: string) => void;
  undo: () => void;
  redo: () => void;
  canUndo: () => boolean;
  canRedo: () => boolean;
  isLoading: boolean;
  setIsLoading: (loading: boolean) => void;
  nsfwMode: NsfwMode;
  setNsfwMode: (mode: NsfwMode) => void;
  zoomLevel: number;
  setZoomLevel: (level: number) => void;
  showGrid: boolean;
  toggleGrid: () => void;
  snapToGrid: boolean;
  toggleSnapToGrid: () => void;
  gridSize: number;
  setGridSize: (size: number) => void;
  forceUpdate: number; 
  forceUpdate: number;
  triggerForceUpdate: () => void;
  // Line drawing state
  isDrawingLine: boolean;
  setIsDrawingLine: (isDrawing: boolean) => void;
  lineStartPoint: { x: number; y: number } | null;
  setLineStartPoint: (point: { x: number; y: number } | null) => void;
  previewLine: FabricLine | null;
  setPreviewLine: (line: FabricLine | null) => void;
  // Polyline drawing state
  isDrawingPolyline: boolean;
  setIsDrawingPolyline: (isDrawing: boolean) => void;
  currentPolylinePoints: { x: number; y: number }[];
  setCurrentPolylinePoints: (points: { x: number; y: number }[]) => void;
  previewPolylineSegment: FabricLine | null;
  setPreviewPolylineSegment: (line: FabricLine | null) => void;
}
const useDesignStudioStore = create<DesignStudioState>((set, get) => ({
  fabricCanvas: null,
  setFabricCanvas: (canvas) => set({ fabricCanvas: canvas, zoomLevel: canvas?.getZoom() || 1 }),
  activeTool: 'Select',
  setActiveTool: (tool) => {
    const canvas = get().fabricCanvas;
    if (canvas) {
      canvas.isDrawingMode = false; // Default to false
      canvas.selection = tool === 'Select'; // Enable selection only for Select tool
      canvas.isDrawingMode = false;
      canvas.selection = tool === 'Select';
      canvas.defaultCursor = tool === 'Select' ? 'default' : 'crosshair';
      canvas.hoverCursor = tool === 'Select' ? 'move' : 'crosshair';
      if (tool === 'Pen') {
        canvas.isDrawingMode = true;
        const { color, width } = get().brushSettings;
        const { color, width }_ = get().brushSettings;
        const pencilBrush = new fabric.PencilBrush(canvas);
        pencilBrush.color = color;
        pencilBrush.width = width;
        canvas.freeDrawingBrush = pencilBrush;
      } else if (tool === 'Eraser') {
        canvas.isDrawingMode = true;
        const { width } = get().brushSettings;
        const pencilEraser = new fabric.PencilBrush(canvas);
        pencilEraser.color = '#ffffff'; 
        pencilEraser.color = '#ffffff';
        pencilEraser.width = width;
        canvas.freeDrawingBrush = pencilEraser;
      } else if (tool === 'Line') {
        // Line tool specific setup (mostly handled by mouse events)
        // If there was a preview line from an incomplete draw, clear it
        const { previewLine, setPreviewLine, setIsDrawingLine, setLineStartPoint } = get();
        if (previewLine) {
          canvas.remove(previewLine);
          setPreviewLine(null);
        }
        setIsDrawingLine(false);
        setLineStartPoint(null);
      } else if (tool === 'Polyline') {
        const { previewPolylineSegment, setPreviewPolylineSegment, setIsDrawingPolyline, setCurrentPolylinePoints } = get();
        if (previewPolylineSegment) {
            canvas.remove(previewPolylineSegment);
            setPreviewPolylineSegment(null);
        }
        // Clear any existing temporary points rendered on canvas if they are separate objects
        canvas.getObjects('temp-polyline-point').forEach(obj => canvas.remove(obj));
        canvas.renderAll();
        setIsDrawingPolyline(false);
        setCurrentPolylinePoints([]);
      }
      if (tool !== 'Select' && canvas.discardActiveObject) {
      if (tool !== 'Select' && canvas.getActiveObject()) {
        canvas.discardActiveObject();
        canvas.renderAll();
      }
    }
    set({ activeTool: tool });
    if (tool !== 'Select') set({ selectedObjects: [] });
  },
  artboardSize: { width: DEFAULT_ARTBOARD_WIDTH, height: DEFAULT_ARTBOARD_HEIGHT },
  setArtboardSize: (size) => {
    const canvas = get().fabricCanvas;
    if (canvas) {
        canvas.setWidth(size.width).setHeight(size.height);
        canvas.renderAll();
        canvas.calcOffset();
        get().addToHistory(JSON.stringify(canvas.toJSON(['id', 'layerName', 'selectable', 'evented', 'visible', 'brushType'])));
    }
    set({ artboardSize: size });
  },
  selectedObjects: [],
  setSelectedObjects: (objects) => set({ selectedObjects: objects }),
  brushSettings: {
    color: PREDEFINED_COLORS[0],
    width: 5,
    type: BrushType.Pen,
    opacity: 1,
  },
  setBrushSettings: (settings) => {
    const newSettings = { ...get().brushSettings, ...settings };
    set({ brushSettings: newSettings });
    const canvas = get().fabricCanvas;
    if (canvas?.isDrawingMode && canvas.freeDrawingBrush) {
      const currentActiveTool = get().activeTool;
      if (currentActiveTool === 'Pen' && canvas.freeDrawingBrush instanceof fabric.PencilBrush) {
        canvas.freeDrawingBrush.color = newSettings.color;
        canvas.freeDrawingBrush.width = newSettings.width;
      } else if (currentActiveTool === 'Eraser' && canvas.freeDrawingBrush instanceof fabric.PencilBrush) {
         canvas.freeDrawingBrush.width = newSettings.width;
         canvas.freeDrawingBrush.color = '#ffffff';
      }
    }
  },
  history: [],
  historyIndex: -1,
  addToHistory: (state) => {
    set(s => {
      const newHistory = s.history.slice(0, s.historyIndex + 1);
      newHistory.push(state);
      const limitedHistory = newHistory.slice(-MAX_HISTORY_STACK);
      return { history: limitedHistory, historyIndex: limitedHistory.length - 1 };
    });
  },
  undo: () => {
    const { history, historyIndex, fabricCanvas, setSelectedObjects: currentSetSelectedObjects, triggerForceUpdate } = get();
    if (historyIndex > 0) {
      const newIndex = historyIndex - 1;
      const prevState = history[newIndex];
      if (fabricCanvas?.loadFromJSON) {
        fabricCanvas.discardActiveObject();
        fabricCanvas.loadFromJSON(prevState, () => {
          fabricCanvas.renderAll();
          currentSetSelectedObjects([]); 
          triggerForceUpdate(); 
          currentSetSelectedObjects([]);
          triggerForceUpdate();
        });
      }
      set({ historyIndex: newIndex });
    }
  },
  redo: () => {
    const { history, historyIndex, fabricCanvas, setSelectedObjects: currentSetSelectedObjects, triggerForceUpdate } = get();
    if (historyIndex < history.length - 1) {
      const newIndex = historyIndex + 1;
      const nextState = history[newIndex];
      if (fabricCanvas?.loadFromJSON) {
        fabricCanvas.discardActiveObject();
        fabricCanvas.loadFromJSON(nextState, () => {
          fabricCanvas.renderAll();
          currentSetSelectedObjects([]); 
          currentSetSelectedObjects([]);
          triggerForceUpdate();
        });
      }
      set({ historyIndex: newIndex });
    }
  },
  canUndo: () => get().historyIndex > 0,
  canRedo: () => get().historyIndex < get().history.length - 1,
  isLoading: false,
  setIsLoading: (loading) => set({ isLoading: loading }),
  nsfwMode: NsfwMode.OFF,
  setNsfwMode: (mode) => set({ nsfwMode: mode }),
  zoomLevel: 1,
  setZoomLevel: (level) => set({ zoomLevel: Math.max(0.1, Math.min(level, 10)) }),
  showGrid: false,
  toggleGrid: () => set(state => ({ showGrid: !state.showGrid })),
  snapToGrid: false,
  toggleSnapToGrid: () => set(state => ({ snapToGrid: !state.snapToGrid })),
  gridSize: 20,
  setGridSize: (size) => set({ gridSize: Math.max(5, size) }),
  forceUpdate: 0,
  triggerForceUpdate: () => set(state => ({ forceUpdate: state.forceUpdate + 1 })),
  // Line drawing state implementation
  isDrawingLine: false,
  setIsDrawingLine: (isDrawing) => set({ isDrawingLine: isDrawing }),
  lineStartPoint: null,
  setLineStartPoint: (point) => set({ lineStartPoint: point }),
  previewLine: null,
  setPreviewLine: (line) => set({ previewLine: line }),
  // Polyline drawing state implementation
  isDrawingPolyline: false,
  setIsDrawingPolyline: (isDrawing) => set({ isDrawingPolyline: isDrawing }),
  currentPolylinePoints: [],
  setCurrentPolylinePoints: (points) => set({ currentPolylinePoints: points }),
  previewPolylineSegment: null,
  setPreviewPolylineSegment: (line) => set({ previewPolylineSegment: line }),
}));
// --- Main Canvas Component ---
function CanvasArea() {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const canvasContainerRef = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const canvasRef = React.useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const imageUploadInputRef = React.useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const temporaryVisualPointsRef = React.useRef<fabric.Circle[]>([]);
  const {
    fabricCanvas, setFabricCanvas, activeTool, setActiveTool, artboardSize, setArtboardSize,
    selectedObjects, setSelectedObjects, brushSettings, setBrushSettings,
    addToHistory: stateAddToHistory, undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo,
    isLoading, setIsLoading, zoomLevel, setZoomLevel, triggerForceUpdate,
    isDrawingLine, setIsDrawingLine, lineStartPoint, setLineStartPoint, previewLine, setPreviewLine,
    isDrawingPolyline, setIsDrawingPolyline, currentPolylinePoints, setCurrentPolylinePoints, previewPolylineSegment, setPreviewPolylineSegment,
  } = useDesignStudioStore();
  const currentAddToHistory = React.useCallback((canvasInstance: FabricCanvas | null) => {
      if (!canvasInstance) return;
      stateAddToHistory(JSON.stringify(canvasInstance.toJSON(['id', 'layerName', 'selectable', 'evented', 'visible', 'brushType'])));
      triggerForceUpdate();
  }, [stateAddToHistory, triggerForceUpdate]);
  // Effect for Escape key to cancel polyline drawing
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
        const { activeTool: currentTool, isDrawingPolyline: drawingPoly, fabricCanvas: currentCanvas } = useDesignStudioStore.getState();
        if (event.key === 'Escape' && currentTool === 'Polyline' && drawingPoly && currentCanvas) {
            const { setPreviewPolylineSegment: setPrevPolySeg, setIsDrawingPolyline: setDrawingPoly, setCurrentPolylinePoints: setCurrPolyPts } = useDesignStudioStore.getState();
            // Remove temporary visual points
            temporaryVisualPointsRef.current.forEach(pointObj => currentCanvas.remove(pointObj));
            temporaryVisualPointsRef.current = [];
            if (useDesignStudioStore.getState().previewPolylineSegment) {
                currentCanvas.remove(useDesignStudioStore.getState().previewPolylineSegment!);
                setPrevPolySeg(null);
            }
            setDrawingPoly(false);
            setCurrPolyPts([]);
            currentCanvas.renderAll();
            toast({ title: 'Polyline Canceled', description: 'Current polyline drawing has been canceled.' });
        }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => {
        window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [toast]); // Dependencies are minimal as we get fresh state inside
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!canvasRef.current) return;
    const canvasInstance = new fabric.Canvas(canvasRef.current, {
      width: artboardSize.width,
      height: artboardSize.height,
      backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
      preserveObjectStacking: true,
      selectionColor: 'rgba(100, 100, 255, 0.3)',
      selectionBorderColor: 'rgba(100, 100, 255, 0.7)',
      selectionLineWidth: 1,
      stopContextMenu: true,
    });
    setFabricCanvas(canvasInstance);
    const handleSelection = (e: fabric.IEvent) => {
      setSelectedObjects(canvasInstance.getActiveObjects() as FabricObject[]);
      if (canvasInstance.getActiveObjects().length > 0 && useDesignStudioStore.getState().activeTool !== 'Select') {
        setActiveTool('Select');
      }
      triggerForceUpdate();
    };
    const handleSelectionCleared = () => {
        setSelectedObjects([]);
        triggerForceUpdate();
    };
    
    const handleObjectModified = (e: fabric.IEvent) => {
      if (e.target) {
         currentAddToHistory(canvasInstance);
      }
    };
    const handlePathCreated = (e: fabric.IEvent & { path?: fabric.Path }) => {
      if (e.path) {
        e.path.set({ opacity: useDesignStudioStore.getState().brushSettings.opacity });
        (e.path as FabricObject).id = Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2);
        (e.path as FabricObject).layerName = 'Drawing';
        (e.path as FabricObject).brushType = useDesignStudioStore.getState().brushSettings.type;
        currentAddToHistory(canvasInstance);
      }
    };
    // Line Drawing Handlers
    const handleMouseDown = (o: fabric.IEvent) => {
        const currentActiveTool = useDesignStudioStore.getState().activeTool;
        const currentIsDrawingLine = useDesignStudioStore.getState().isDrawingLine;
        if (currentActiveTool === 'Line' && !currentIsDrawingLine) {
            const pointer = canvasInstance.getPointer(o.e);
            setLineStartPoint({ x: pointer.x, y: pointer.y });
            setIsDrawingLine(true);
        const pointer = canvasInstance.getPointer(o.e);
            const { color, width, opacity } = useDesignStudioStore.getState().brushSettings;
            const tempLine = new fabric.Line([pointer.x, pointer.y, pointer.x, pointer.y], {
                stroke: color,
                strokeWidth: width,
                opacity: opacity,
                selectable: false,
                evented: false,
            }) as FabricLine;
            canvasInstance.add(tempLine);
            setPreviewLine(tempLine);
        if (currentActiveTool === 'Line') {
            const { isDrawingLine: currentIsDrawingLine, setLineStartPoint: setLsP, setIsDrawingLine: setIsDL, setPreviewLine: setPrL } = useDesignStudioStore.getState();
            if (!currentIsDrawingLine) {
                setLsP({ x: pointer.x, y: pointer.y });
                setIsDL(true);
                const { color, width, opacity } = useDesignStudioStore.getState().brushSettings;
                const tempLine = new fabric.Line([pointer.x, pointer.y, pointer.x, pointer.y], {
                    stroke: color, strokeWidth: width, opacity: opacity, selectable: false, evented: false,
                }) as FabricLine;
                canvasInstance.add(tempLine);
                setPrL(tempLine);
            }
        } else if (currentActiveTool === 'Polyline') {
            const { isDrawingPolyline: drawingPoly, currentPolylinePoints: currentPoints, setCurrentPolylinePoints: setCurrPoints, setIsDrawingPolyline: setDrawingPoly } = useDesignStudioStore.getState();
            const newPoints = [...currentPoints, { x: pointer.x, y: pointer.y }];
            setCurrPoints(newPoints);
            if (!drawingPoly) {
                setDrawingPoly(true);
            }
            // Add a temporary visual marker for the point
            const pointMarker = new fabric.Circle({
                radius: 3, fill: brushSettings.color, left: pointer.x - 3, top: pointer.y - 3,
                selectable: false, evented: false, objectCaching: false, data: {isTempVisual: true}
            });
            // @ts-ignore - custom property
            pointMarker.name = 'temp-polyline-point';
            canvasInstance.add(pointMarker);
            temporaryVisualPointsRef.current.push(pointMarker);
            canvasInstance.renderAll();
        }
    };
    const handleMouseMove = (o: fabric.IEvent) => {
        const currentActiveTool = useDesignStudioStore.getState().activeTool;
        const currentIsDrawingLine = useDesignStudioStore.getState().isDrawingLine;
        const currentPreviewLine = useDesignStudioStore.getState().previewLine;
        if (currentActiveTool === 'Line' && currentIsDrawingLine && currentPreviewLine) {
            const pointer = canvasInstance.getPointer(o.e);
            currentPreviewLine.set({ x2: pointer.x, y2: pointer.y });
            canvasInstance.requestRenderAll();
        const pointer = canvasInstance.getPointer(o.e);
        if (currentActiveTool === 'Line') {
            const { isDrawingLine: currentIsDrawingLine, previewLine: currentPreviewLine } = useDesignStudioStore.getState();
            if (currentIsDrawingLine && currentPreviewLine) {
                currentPreviewLine.set({ x2: pointer.x, y2: pointer.y });
                canvasInstance.requestRenderAll();
            }
        } else if (currentActiveTool === 'Polyline') {
            const { isDrawingPolyline: drawingPoly, currentPolylinePoints: currentPoints, previewPolylineSegment: currentPreviewSeg, setPreviewPolylineSegment: setPrevPolySeg } = useDesignStudioStore.getState();
            if (drawingPoly && currentPoints.length > 0) {
                const lastPoint = currentPoints[currentPoints.length - 1];
                if (currentPreviewSeg) {
                    currentPreviewSeg.set({ x1: lastPoint.x, y1: lastPoint.y, x2: pointer.x, y2: pointer.y });
                } else {
                    const { color, width, opacity } = useDesignStudioStore.getState().brushSettings;
                    const tempSeg = new fabric.Line([lastPoint.x, lastPoint.y, pointer.x, pointer.y], {
                        stroke: color, strokeWidth: width / 2, opacity: opacity * 0.7, selectable: false, evented: false, strokeDashArray: [5, 5]
                    }) as FabricLine;
                    canvasInstance.add(tempSeg);
                    setPrevPolySeg(tempSeg);
                }
                canvasInstance.requestRenderAll();
            }
        }
    };
    const handleMouseUp = (o: fabric.IEvent) => {
        const currentActiveTool = useDesignStudioStore.getState().activeTool;
        const currentIsDrawingLine = useDesignStudioStore.getState().isDrawingLine;
        const currentLineStartPoint = useDesignStudioStore.getState().lineStartPoint;
        const currentPreviewLine = useDesignStudioStore.getState().previewLine;
        if (currentActiveTool === 'Line') {
            const { isDrawingLine: currentIsDrawingLine, lineStartPoint: currentLsP, previewLine: currentPrL, setPreviewLine: setPrL, setIsDrawingLine: setIsDL, setLineStartPoint: setLsP } = useDesignStudioStore.getState();
            if (currentIsDrawingLine && currentLsP) {
                if (currentPrL) { canvasInstance.remove(currentPrL); setPrL(null); }
                const pointer = canvasInstance.getPointer(o.e);
                if (Math.abs(currentLsP.x - pointer.x) > 2 || Math.abs(currentLsP.y - pointer.y) > 2) {
                    const { color, width, opacity } = useDesignStudioStore.getState().brushSettings;
                    const finalLine = new fabric.Line([currentLsP.x, currentLsP.y, pointer.x, pointer.y], {
                        stroke: color, strokeWidth: width, opacity: opacity,
                        id: Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2),
                        layerName: 'Line',
                    }) as FabricLine;
                    canvasInstance.add(finalLine);
                    currentAddToHistory(canvasInstance);
                }
                setIsDL(false); setLsP(null);
            }
        }
        // Mouse up for Polyline is effectively a click, handled by mouse:down. Double-click finalizes.
    };
        if (currentActiveTool === 'Line' && currentIsDrawingLine && currentLineStartPoint) {
            if (currentPreviewLine) {
                canvasInstance.remove(currentPreviewLine);
                setPreviewLine(null);
            }
            const pointer = canvasInstance.getPointer(o.e);
            // Check if start and end points are different enough
            if (Math.abs(currentLineStartPoint.x - pointer.x) > 2 || Math.abs(currentLineStartPoint.y - pointer.y) > 2) {
    const handleMouseDoubleClick = (o: fabric.IEvent) => {
        const currentActiveTool = useDesignStudioStore.getState().activeTool;
        if (currentActiveTool === 'Polyline') {
            const { isDrawingPolyline: drawingPoly, currentPolylinePoints: currentPoints, previewPolylineSegment: currentPreviewSeg,
                    setCurrentPolylinePoints: setCurrPoints, setIsDrawingPolyline: setDrawingPoly, setPreviewPolylineSegment: setPrevPolySeg } = useDesignStudioStore.getState();
            if (drawingPoly && currentPoints.length >= 2) {
                // Remove temporary visual points
                temporaryVisualPointsRef.current.forEach(pointObj => canvasInstance.remove(pointObj));
                temporaryVisualPointsRef.current = [];
                if (currentPreviewSeg) {
                    canvasInstance.remove(currentPreviewSeg);
                    setPrevPolySeg(null);
                }
                const { color, width, opacity } = useDesignStudioStore.getState().brushSettings;
                const finalLine = new fabric.Line([currentLineStartPoint.x, currentLineStartPoint.y, pointer.x, pointer.y], {
                    stroke: color,
                    strokeWidth: width,
                    opacity: opacity,
                const finalPolyline = new fabric.Polyline(currentPoints, {
                    stroke: color, strokeWidth: width, opacity: opacity, fill: 'transparent', // Polylines are not filled by default
                    id: Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2),
                    layerName: 'Line',
                }) as FabricLine;
                canvasInstance.add(finalLine);
                    layerName: 'Polyline',
                    objectCaching: false, // May help with rendering updates for complex polylines
                }) as FabricPolyline;
                canvasInstance.add(finalPolyline);
                currentAddToHistory(canvasInstance);
                setCurrPoints([]);
                setDrawingPoly(false);
                // The tool remains active for the next polyline
            }
            setIsDrawingLine(false);
            setLineStartPoint(null);
        }
    };
    canvasInstance.on('selection:created', handleSelection);
    canvasInstance.on('selection:updated', handleSelection);
    canvasInstance.on('selection:cleared', handleSelectionCleared);
    canvasInstance.on('object:modified', handleObjectModified);
    canvasInstance.on('path:created', handlePathCreated);
    canvasInstance.on('mouse:down', handleMouseDown);
    canvasInstance.on('mouse:move', handleMouseMove);
    canvasInstance.on('mouse:up', handleMouseUp);
    canvasInstance.on('mouse:dblclick', handleMouseDoubleClick);
    if (useDesignStudioStore.getState().history.length === 0) {
      currentAddToHistory(canvasInstance);
    }
    triggerForceUpdate();
    return () => {
      canvasInstance.off('selection:created', handleSelection);
      canvasInstance.off('selection:updated', handleSelection);
      canvasInstance.off('selection:cleared', handleSelectionCleared);
      canvasInstance.off('object:modified', handleObjectModified);
      canvasInstance.off('path:created', handlePathCreated);
      canvasInstance.off('mouse:down', handleMouseDown);
      canvasInstance.off('mouse:move', handleMouseMove);
      canvasInstance.off('mouse:up', handleMouseUp);
      canvasInstance.off('mouse:dblclick', handleMouseDoubleClick);
      canvasInstance.dispose();
      setFabricCanvas(null);
    };
  }, [setFabricCanvas, setSelectedObjects, setActiveTool, currentAddToHistory, artboardSize.width, artboardSize.height, triggerForceUpdate, setIsDrawingLine, setLineStartPoint, setPreviewLine]);
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [artboardSize.width, artboardSize.height]); // Only re-init canvas if artboard size changes drastically
  const quickColorSwatches = (onSelect: (color: string) => void, currentColor: string, onFinalChange?: () => void) => (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-8 gap-1.5 mt-2">
      {PREDEFINED_COLORS.map(color => (
        <TooltipProvider key={color} delayDuration={100}>
          <Tooltip>
            <TooltipTrigger asChild>
              <button
                type="button"
                className={cn(
                  "w-full h-5 rounded border-2 transition-all",
                  currentColor.toLowerCase() === color.toLowerCase() ? 'border-ring ring-1 ring-ring ring-offset-1 ring-offset-background' : 'border-muted-foreground/20 hover:border-muted-foreground/50'
                )}
                style={{ backgroundColor: color }}
                onClick={() => { onSelect(color); if (onFinalChange) onFinalChange(); }}
                aria-label={`Select color ${color}`}
              />
            </TooltipTrigger>
            <TooltipContent side="top" align="center"><p>{color}</p></TooltipContent>
          </Tooltip>
        </TooltipProvider>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
  const addRectangle = () => {
    if (!fabricCanvas) return;
    const rect = new fabric.Rect({
      left: fabricCanvas.getCenter().left - 75,
      top: fabricCanvas.getCenter().top - 50,
      fill: brushSettings.color,
      width: 150,
      height: 100,
      opacity: brushSettings.opacity,
      id: Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2),
      layerName: 'Rectangle',
      visible: true,
    });
    fabricCanvas.add(rect);
    fabricCanvas.setActiveObject(rect);
    currentAddToHistory(fabricCanvas);
    setActiveTool('Select');
  };
  const addEllipse = () => {
    if (!fabricCanvas) return;
    const ellipse = new fabric.Ellipse({
      left: fabricCanvas.getCenter().left - 75,
      top: fabricCanvas.getCenter().top - 50,
      fill: brushSettings.color,
      rx: 75,
      ry: 50,
      opacity: brushSettings.opacity,

  const handleImageFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (!fabricCanvas) return;
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      setIsLoading(true);
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = (f) => {
        fabric.Image.fromURL(f.target?.result as string, (img) => {
          const baseName = file.name.split('.')[0] || 'Image';
          let layerName = baseName;
          let counter = 1;
          // Ensure unique layer name
          while (fabricCanvas.getObjects().some(obj => (obj as FabricObject).layerName === layerName)) {
            layerName = `${baseName} ${counter}`;
            counter++;
          }
          (img as FabricObject).set({
            left: fabricCanvas.getCenter().left - (img.width || 100) / 2,
            top: fabricCanvas.getCenter().top - (img.height || 100) / 2,
            id: Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2),
            layerName: layerName,
            visible: true,
          });
          const maxDim = Math.min(artboardSize.width, artboardSize.height) * 0.5;
          if (img.width && img.height) {
             img.scaleToWidth(Math.min(img.width, maxDim));
             if (img.getScaledHeight() > maxDim) {
                img.scaleToHeight(Math.min(img.getScaledHeight(), maxDim));
             }
          }
          fabricCanvas.add(img);
          fabricCanvas.setActiveObject(img);
          fabricCanvas.renderAll();
          currentAddToHistory(fabricCanvas);
          setIsLoading(false);
          setActiveTool('Select');
        }, { crossOrigin: 'anonymous' });
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
      if (imageUploadInputRef.current) imageUploadInputRef.current.value = "";
    }

      fabricCanvas.remove(group);

        fabricCanvas.add(items[i]); 
      // @ts-ignore Fabric's own type definitions are sometimes incomplete for private methods.
      // group.toActiveSelection() is the modern way to do this.
      // If group.toActiveSelection is not available, then use group._restoreObjectsState() and manual add.
      if (typeof group.toActiveSelection === 'function') {
        group.toActiveSelection();
        // group.destroy(); // toActiveSelection should handle removing the group itself.
        // Need to confirm this behavior or explicitly remove if not.
        // For safety, after toActiveSelection, we might need to explicitly remove `group`.
        // Let's assume `toActiveSelection` handles it as it typically replaces the group.
        // If items are not re-added, it means we need to manually add them.
        // The new active selection handles the objects.
      } else {
        // Fallback for older Fabric.js or if toActiveSelection is not found
        const items = group._objects;
        group._restoreObjectsState(); // Restores state to individual objects
        fabricCanvas.remove(group); // Remove the group object

          fabricCanvas.add(items[i]); // Re-add individual items
        }
        const sel = new fabric.ActiveSelection(items, { canvas: fabricCanvas });
        fabricCanvas.setActiveObject(sel);
      }

      fabricCanvas.setActiveObject(sel);

      currentAddToHistory(fabricCanvas);

  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  ], [activeTool, setActiveTool, undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo, selectedObjects, fabricCanvas, brushSettings.color, brushSettings.opacity, currentAddToHistory]); // currentAddToHistory was missing, might be fine if it's stable

         const icon = obj.type === 'group' ? GroupIcon : 
                      obj.type === 'line' ? Minus : 
                      obj.type === 'path' ? PenTool : 
                      Edit3;
         const specificProperties = [];
         if (obj.type === 'line' || obj.type === 'path') {
            const lineOrPath = obj as FabricLine | FabricObject; // FabricObject for path
            specificProperties.push(
                <div key="stroke-color">
                    <Label htmlFor="line-stroke-color" className="text-xs">Color</Label>
                    <Input id="line-stroke-color" type="color" value={lineOrPath.stroke || '#000000'} 
                        onChange={e => {lineOrPath.set('stroke', e.target.value); fabricCanvas?.renderAll();}} 
                        onBlurCapture={() => currentAddToHistory(fabricCanvas)} 
                        className="h-8 w-full p-0.5 box-border"/>
                    {quickColorSwatches(color => {lineOrPath.set('stroke', color); fabricCanvas?.renderAll();}, lineOrPath.stroke || '#000000', () => currentAddToHistory(fabricCanvas))}
                </div>,
                <div key="stroke-width">
                    <Label htmlFor="line-stroke-width" className="text-xs">Thickness: {lineOrPath.strokeWidth || 1}px</Label>
                    <Slider id="line-stroke-width" min={1} max={100} step={1} value={[lineOrPath.strokeWidth || 1]} 
                            onValueChange={val => {lineOrPath.set('strokeWidth', val[0]); fabricCanvas?.renderAll();}} 
                            onPointerUp={() => currentAddToHistory(fabricCanvas)} />
                </div>
            );
             if (obj.type === 'path' && (obj as FabricObject).brushType) {
                specificProperties.push(
                    <div key="brush-type-display">
                        <Label className="text-xs">Brush Style Used</Label>
                        <p className="text-xs text-foreground/80 p-2 bg-muted/50 rounded-md">
                            {(obj as FabricObject).brushType?.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + (obj as FabricObject).brushType!.slice(1).replace(/-/g, ' ') }
                        </p>
                    </div>
                );
            }
         }
         
         panels.push({
            value: 'generic-object-properties', title: title, icon: icon,
            content: (<div className="space-y-3 p-1">{commonObjectProperties} {specificProperties}</div>)
         });
      }
    }
    
    return panels;
  }, [
    fabricCanvas, activeTool, brushSettings, setBrushSettings, artboardSize, setArtboardSize, 
    selectedObjects, currentAddToHistory, quickColorSwatches, layers, triggerForceUpdate,
    // Removed line-specific state from dependencies as they are handled by tool-specific panel
  ]);
  return (
    <SidebarProvider defaultOpen>
      <LeftNav activePageLabel="Design Studio" />
      <div className="flex flex-1 h-screen">
        <SidebarInset className="flex-1 flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
          <input type="file" ref={imageUploadInputRef} onChange={handleImageFileChange} className="hidden" accept="image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp, image/svg+xml" />
          <TopBar
            onNewDesign={() => {
                if (fabricCanvas) {
                    fabricCanvas.clear();
                    fabricCanvas.backgroundColor = '#ffffff';
                    fabricCanvas.renderAll();
                    useDesignStudioStore.setState({ history: [], historyIndex: -1 }); 
                    currentAddToHistory(fabricCanvas); 
                    toast({title: "New Design Started"});
                }
            }}
            onSaveDesignAs={() => { 
              if (!fabricCanvas) return;
              const dataURL = fabricCanvas.toDataURL({ format: 'png', quality: 1 });
              const link = document.createElement('a');
              const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-');
              link.download = `arttoo-design-${timestamp}.png`;
              link.href = dataURL;
              document.body.appendChild(link);
              link.click();
              document.body.removeChild(link);
              toast({title: "Design Saved as PNG"});
            }}
            onOpenDesign={() => { toast({title: "Open (Not Implemented)"}); }}
            onCopy={() => { 
              if (!fabricCanvas?.getActiveObject()) return;
              fabricCanvas.getActiveObject()?.clone((cloned: FabricObject) => {
                // @ts-ignore
                fabricCanvas.clipboard = cloned;
                toast({title: "Object Copied"});
              });
            }}
            onPaste={() => {
              if (!fabricCanvas || !(fabricCanvas as any).clipboard) return;
              (fabricCanvas as any).clipboard.clone((clonedObj: FabricObject) => {
                fabricCanvas.discardActiveObject();
                clonedObj.set({
                  left: (clonedObj.left || 0) + 10,
                  top: (clonedObj.top || 0) + 10,
                  evented: true, 
                  id: Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2), 
                });
                if ((clonedObj as any).type === 'activeSelection') {
                  const activeSelection = clonedObj as fabric.ActiveSelection;
                  activeSelection.canvas = fabricCanvas;
                  activeSelection.forEachObject((obj: FabricObject) => {
                    obj.id = Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2);
                    fabricCanvas.add(obj);
                  });
                  activeSelection.setCoords();
                } else {
                  fabricCanvas.add(clonedObj);
                }
                // @ts-ignore
                if (fabricCanvas.clipboard) {
                    // @ts-ignore
                    fabricCanvas.clipboard.top = (fabricCanvas.clipboard.top || 0) + 10;
                    // @ts-ignore
                    fabricCanvas.clipboard.left = (fabricCanvas.clipboard.left || 0) + 10;
                }
                fabricCanvas.setActiveObject(clonedObj);
                fabricCanvas.requestRenderAll();
                currentAddToHistory(fabricCanvas);
                toast({title: "Object Pasted"});
              });
            }}
            canCopy={selectedObjects.length > 0}
            canPaste={fabricCanvas && !!(fabricCanvas as any).clipboard}
            onUndo={undo}
            onRedo={redo}
            canUndo={canUndo()}
            canRedo={canRedo()}
            onZoomIn={() => { if (fabricCanvas) { const newZoom = fabricCanvas.getZoom() * 1.1; fabricCanvas.setZoom(newZoom); fabricCanvas.renderAll(); setZoomLevel(newZoom); } }}
            onZoomOut={() => { if (fabricCanvas) { const newZoom = fabricCanvas.getZoom() / 1.1; fabricCanvas.setZoom(newZoom); fabricCanvas.renderAll(); setZoomLevel(newZoom); } }}
            onResetZoom={() => { if (fabricCanvas) { fabricCanvas.setViewportTransform(fabric.iMatrix.concat()); fabricCanvas.setZoom(1); setZoomLevel(1); fabricCanvas.renderAll(); } }}
            currentZoomLevel={`${(zoomLevel * 100).toFixed(0)}%`}
            onGroup={handleGroupObjects}
            canGroup={canGroup}
            onUngroup={handleUngroupObjects}
            canUngroup={canUngroup}
          />
          <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col md:flex-row overflow-hidden">
            <VerticalToolbar
              items={designStudioToolbarItems}
              activeToolLabel={activeTool}
              onToolItemClick={(label) => {
                const toolItem = designStudioToolbarItems.find(item => item.label === label);
                toolItem?.action?.();
              }}
            />
            <section
              ref={canvasContainerRef}
              className="flex-1 bg-muted/30 flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden p-0 md:p-4 touch-none relative"
            >
              <div className="shadow-lg bg-white"> 
                <canvas ref={canvasRef} />
              </div>
              {isLoading && (
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-background/70 flex items-center justify-center z-50">
                  <Loader2 className="h-12 w-12 animate-spin text-primary" />
                  <p className="ml-3 text-lg font-semibold">Processing...</p>
                </div>
              )}
            </section>
          </div>
        </SidebarInset>
        <RightProperties 
            items={rightPropertiesItems} 
            title="Properties" 
            defaultOpenValue={
                activeTool === 'Pen' ? 'pen-properties' :
                activeTool === 'Eraser' ? 'eraser-properties' :
                activeTool === 'Line' ? 'line-tool-properties' :
                layers.length > 0 ? (selectedObjects.length === 1 ? 
                    (selectedObjects[0].type === 'rect' || selectedObjects[0].type === 'ellipse' ? 'shape-properties' : 
                    (selectedObjects[0].type === 'i-text' ? 'text-properties' : 
                    (selectedObjects[0].type === 'group' || selectedObjects[0].type === 'line' || selectedObjects[0].type === 'path' ? 'generic-object-properties' : 'layers'))) 
                    : 'layers') 
                : 'artboard-settings'
            }
        />
      </div>
    </SidebarProvider>
  );
}
export default function DesignStudioPage() {
  return <CanvasArea />;
}

Get the current gridSize.
Calculate the new left and top positions by rounding the object's current left and top to the nearest multiple of gridSize.
target.set({ left: Math.round(target.left / gridSize) * gridSize, top: Math.round(target.top / gridSize) * gridSize });
This will snap the object's origin (typically top-left for default Fabric objects) to the grid intersections.
Call target.setCoords() after modifying position to ensure Fabric.js updates its internal coordinates and control bounding boxes.

The Most Impactful and Logical Next Feature: Alignment and Distribution Tools

To significantly enhance layout capabilities, provide a core professional feature, and directly address the "Canva/GIMP-like" experience goal, the next logical step is to implement Alignment and Distribution Tools for selected objects.

Reasoning:

Fundamental Design Capability: Precise alignment and even distribution of multiple objects are essential for creating polished, professional-looking designs. This is a non-negotiable feature in any serious design editor.
Vastly Improved User Experience & Efficiency: Manually aligning multiple objects is tedious and error-prone. These tools make the process quick and accurate.
Builds on Existing Infrastructure: This feature naturally extends our current object selection and manipulation capabilities. The properties panel is the ideal place for these controls.
Addresses "Comprehensive Functionality": Adding robust layout tools is a major step towards the desired level of functionality.
Implementation Plan:

UI in RightProperties Panel (src/app/design-studio/page.tsx):

A new accordion item/section titled "Align & Distribute" (or similar) will be added to the rightPropertiesItems.
This section will only be visible/enabled when two or more objects are selected on the canvas.
It will contain icon buttons for:
Align Left Edges
Align Horizontal Centers
Align Right Edges
Align Top Edges
Align Vertical Centers
Align Bottom Edges
(Distribution tools like "Distribute Horizontal Centers" or "Distribute Vertical Space" can be added as a follow-up if this step becomes too large, or included if time permits).
We'll use appropriate icons from lucide-react (e.g., AlignStartHorizontal, AlignCenterHorizontal, AlignEndHorizontal, AlignStartVertical, AlignCenterVertical, AlignEndVertical).
Alignment Logic (within CanvasArea or Zustand actions):

A new set of functions (e.g., alignObjects(type: AlignmentType)) will be created.
Input: The currently selected objects (fabricCanvas.getActiveObjects()).
Calculations:
For alignment, a reference point/line is determined based on the bounding box of the entire selection (or the first/last object in the selection, depending on the alignment type).
Align Left: Use the left coordinate of the leftmost object in the selection.
Align Right: Use the left + width coordinate of the rightmost object.
Align Top: Use the top coordinate of the topmost object.
Align Bottom: Use the top + height coordinate of the bottommost object.
Align Horizontal Centers: Calculate the horizontal center of the bounding box that encompasses all selected objects. Then, for each object, set its left to (referenceCenter - object.width * object.scaleX / 2). (Need to account for originX).
Align Vertical Centers: Similar to horizontal centers, but for the top coordinate.
Applying Alignment:
Iterate through each selected object.
Update its left or top property based on the calculated reference and the object's own dimensions (and originX/originY if not 'left'/'top').
Call object.setCoords() after updating position/dimensions to update controls.
After all objects are updated:
fabricCanvas.requestRenderAll().
Add the operation to the history stack (currentAddToHistory(fabricCanvas)).
Considerations for Fabric.js:

Object Origin: Fabric.js objects have originX and originY properties (defaulting to 'left' and 'top'). Alignment calculations must respect these origins. If an object's origin is 'center', setting its left property behaves differently than if its origin is 'left'. For simplicity in the first pass, we might assume default origins or ensure our calculations are robust.
Scaled Objects: object.width and object.height give unscaled dimensions. object.getScaledWidth() and object.getScaledHeight() are needed for accurate bounding box calculations.
Rotated Objects: Aligning based on the visual bounding box of rotated objects can be complex. Initially, we might align based on their unrotated bounding box corners relative to the canvas, or their center points. Fabric's o.getBoundingRect() can provide the visual bounding box after transformations.
Groups: Aligning a group should move the group as a whole. Aligning objects within a group is a more advanced feature. Our current selection logic should handle this correctly if the group itself is the selected object.
State Management (Zustand):

The primary trigger will be UI button clicks. The enabling/disabling of alignment buttons will depend on selectedObjects.length >= 2.
This is a feature-rich step that will significantly enhance the Design Studio's usability for layout tasks.

Ahoy Cap'n! This is another hydration error, very similar to the one we tackled before with the button text in TryOnCanvas.

The error message indicates a mismatch for the Switch component used for the "NSFW Mode" toggle within the "AI Realistic Blend" section of the TryOnPage:

+                               aria-checked={true}
-                               aria-checked="false"
+                               data-state="checked"
-                               data-state="unchecked"
This means the server rendered the switch as "unchecked" (aria-checked="false", data-state="unchecked"), but the client's initial render saw it as "checked".

The checked prop for this switch is determined by: checked={nsfwMode === NsfwMode.ON}

And nsfwMode state in src/app/try-on/page.tsx is initialized using: useState<NsfwMode>(() => loadStateFromLS(LS_NSFW_MODE_KEY, NsfwMode.OFF));

The Problem: Just like before, localStorage (used by loadStateFromLS) isn't available on the server.

Server-Side (SSR/SSG): loadStateFromLS returns its default value (NsfwMode.OFF). So, nsfwMode is NsfwMode.OFF, the condition nsfwMode === NsfwMode.ON is false, and the server renders an unchecked switch.
Client-Side (Initial Render): If localStorage contains LS_NSFW_MODE_KEY set to "ON", loadStateFromLS will return NsfwMode.ON. This makes nsfwMode === NsfwMode.ON true, and React renders a checked switch.
This mismatch causes the hydration error.

The Fix: We need to ensure the initial client render matches the server. We'll modify src/app/try-on/page.tsx to:

Initialize nsfwMode state with the default value (NsfwMode.OFF) directly in useState.
Use the existing useEffect hook (the one that runs once after the component mounts and already loads other LS values) to also load the nsfwMode from localStorage and update the state.
This ensures the first client render is consistent with the server, and then localStorage values are applied.

Here are the changes to src/app/try-on/page.tsx: (Omitted from agent history: changes suggested and applied to the following files: /src/app/try-on/page.tsx) This change ensures that the nsfwMode state is initialized to NsfwMode.OFF for both server and initial client renders. The useEffect hook then correctly loads the persisted value from localStorage after hydration, preventing the mismatch. This should resolve the hydration error for the NSFW switch.

Test with BLOCK_NONE for all categories if NsfwMode.ON: This is already what NsfwMode.ON does. If this still fails, the content might be truly problematic for the model or there's a very sensitive hidden filter.

Let's refine the error handling and ensure the safety settings are robustly applied, especially for the remove-background flow which might encounter a wide variety of user-uploaded images.

Since the immediate error is a "Generation blocked" precondition, the primary fix is to ensure that when NsfwMode.ON is selected by the user, the safety settings are as permissive as possible for all harm categories that can be configured. The current remove-background.ts already does this by setting BLOCK_NONE for several categories when NSFW mode is ON.

The error indicates the blocking is happening despite these settings. This could mean: a. The image content hits an unconfigurable "BLOCK_ALWAYS" threshold (e.g., CSAM). b. There's a specific harm category not being explicitly set to BLOCK_NONE that's causing the issue. Google's safety settings can be quite granular. c. The "text" part of the prompt, even if benign, combined with a borderline image, triggers the filter.

Given the FAILED_PRECONDITION from Genkit, and assuming our nsfwMode logic for safetySettings is correctly implemented (which it appears to be), this error often means the content itself is hitting a hard limit of the safety system that even BLOCK_NONE on configurable categories cannot bypass.

However, let's ensure our NsfwMode.ON is maximally permissive by including all known configurable harm categories.

Gemini
Ahoy, Cap'n! My apologies, this hydration error with the Switch component is a persistent gremlin. It means the server and the client are still not agreeing on the initial state of that NSFW toggle.

The root cause is, as before, accessing localStorage (via loadStateFromLS) during the initial render phase on the client, leading to a different outcome than the server's render.

Looking at your src/app/try-on/page.tsx, the nsfwMode state is initialized as: const [nsfwMode, setNsfwMode] = useState<NsfwMode>(() => loadStateFromLS(LS_NSFW_MODE_KEY, NsfwMode.OFF));

This initializer function () => loadStateFromLS(...) runs:

On the server: typeof window is undefined, so loadStateFromLS returns the default NsfwMode.OFF. The server renders the switch as unchecked.
On the client (initial render): typeof window is defined, so loadStateFromLS reads from localStorage. If localStorage has "ON", nsfwMode is initialized to NsfwMode.ON before the first paint. The client renders the switch as checked.
This discrepancy leads to the hydration error.

The Correct Fix:

Initialize nsfwMode with a default value that the server will also use: const [nsfwMode, setNsfwMode] = useState<NsfwMode>(NsfwMode.OFF);
Load the value from localStorage after the component has mounted, using a useEffect hook. This ensures the initial client render matches the server.
It appears the useEffect that loads various states from localStorage is missing the setNsfwMode call for this specific piece of state.

I'll make the following changes to src/app/try-on/page.tsx:

3e26a57d

Restore
I've applied the fix to src/app/try-on/page.tsx:

Changed the nsfwMode state initialization to: const [nsfwMode, setNsfwMode] = useState<NsfwMode>(NsfwMode.OFF);
Ensured that the useEffect hook that runs on mount includes the line: setNsfwMode(loadStateFromLS(LS_NSFW_MODE_KEY, NsfwMode.OFF));
This pattern ensures that the initial render on both server and client uses NsfwMode.OFF, preventing the hydration mismatch. The actual value from localStorage is then applied client-side after the component has mounted. This should resolve the error.

Currently, the "Image Properties" panel has UI placeholders for Brightness, Contrast, and Grayscale, but they don't apply actual visual changes using Fabric.js filters. Making these functional, and potentially adding a few more common filters like Sepia, Saturation, and Blur, will provide users with significant power to modify imported images directly within their designs.

Reasoning:

Enhances Core Functionality: Image manipulation is a fundamental aspect of design software. Adding filters moves ARTTOO closer to the capabilities of tools like Canva or GIMP.
High User Impact: Users frequently need to adjust images (e.g., make them fit a color scheme, apply artistic effects). This directly improves the design workflow.
Builds on Existing Infrastructure:
We have an "Image Properties" panel.
We have fabric.Image objects on the canvas.
Fabric.js provides a robust filtering system (fabric.Image.filters).
Our useDesignStudioStore already has custom properties on FabricImage (brightness, contrast, grayscale) that were intended for this.
Feasibility: Integrating Fabric.js filters is a well-defined task. The main work involves mapping UI controls (sliders, switches) to the creation and application of these filters.
Implementation Plan:

I'll modify src/app/design-studio/page.tsx and src/store/design-studio-store.ts.

src/store/design-studio-store.ts:

Update the FabricImage type definition to include properties for all filters we want to control:
brightnessValue (e.g., 0-200, 100 default)
contrastValue (e.g., 0-200, 100 default)
saturationValue (e.g., 0-200, 100 default)
grayscaleEnabled (boolean)
sepiaEnabled (boolean)
blurValue (e.g., 0-100, 0 default)
When new images are added (handleImageFileChange in design-studio-page.tsx), these new properties will be initialized with their default values.
src/app/design-studio/page.tsx:

In the rightPropertiesItems generation, when an Image object is selected, the "Filters & Adjustments" section will be revamped:
UI Controls: Add sliders for brightnessValue, contrastValue, saturationValue, blurValue. Add switches for grayscaleEnabled and sepiaEnabled.
Filter Application Logic:
Create a helper function (e.g., applyImageFilters(imgObj: FabricImage)) that reads these custom properties from the imgObj.
It will clear any existing filters from imgObj.filters.
It will then conditionally add the corresponding fabric.Image.filters (e.g., fabric.Image.filters.Brightness, fabric.Image.filters.Grayscale) to the imgObj.filters array based on the custom property values.
Brightness/Contrast/Saturation values will be normalized from the UI range (e.g., 0-200) to the range Fabric.js expects (e.g., -1 to 1 for Brightness/Contrast/Saturation, where 0 is no change). So, a UI value of 100 would map to a filter value of 0.
Blur UI value (0-100) will map to Fabric's Blur filter value (0-1).
After constructing the filters array, it will call imgObj.applyFilters() and then fabricCanvas.renderAll().
Event Handling:
onValueChange for sliders/switches will update the corresponding custom property on the imgObj (e.g., imgObj.brightnessValue = newValue).
onPointerUp (for sliders) or onCheckedChange (for switches) will then call applyImageFilters(imgObj) and currentAddToHistory(fabricCanvas).
This approach ensures that the filter state is stored with the object and can be correctly reapplied (e.g., when loading from history).

Strategic Next Step: Implement a Robust Grid, Ruler, and Snapping System in the Design Studio

While we've added features like image filters and enhanced text tools, a core element of "comprehensive functionality and smooth user experience" in any design editor (Canva, GIMP, etc.) is precise layout control. Currently, our grid is basic, and there are no rulers or advanced snapping options beyond simple grid snapping.

Reasoning:

Foundation for Precision: A good grid, ruler, and snapping system is fundamental for users to create professional, well-aligned designs. It moves beyond freeform placement to structured composition.
Directly Addresses "Canva/GIMP-like" Experience: These are standard, expected features in mature design tools. Their absence is noticeable.
User Experience Enhancement: Greatly improves workflow for users who need accuracy in their designs, which is common for tattoo placement and complex patterns.
Impact on Existing Tools: Makes alignment tools more effective, aids in consistent spacing, and helps with creating symmetrical or patterned designs.
Feasibility within Fabric.js: Fabric.js can support this.
Grid: We have a basic grid. It can be enhanced with customizable appearance (major/minor lines, colors), and perhaps dynamic subdivision based on zoom.
Rulers: Can be implemented by drawing custom elements (lines, text for numbers) around the canvas area, which update based on pan/zoom.
Snapping: Fabric.js object events (object:moving, object:scaling) can be used to implement more sophisticated snapping logic (snap to object edges, centers, guides, in addition to grid).

Advanced Snapping Logic (src/app/design-studio/page.tsx):

Object Snapping: When moving/scaling an object, detect proximity to edges or centers of other objects and "snap" to them. This involves iterating through other objects on the canvas.

Snapping Tolerance: Make this configurable in the store/UI.

Core Studios (MVP Level):

Design Studio (Fabric.js): Rudimentary object creation (shapes, text with basic styling, image import), a very basic pen/eraser, and initial implementations of transform, grouping, alignment, and image filters. Layer panel exists. Undo/redo is functional.
Digital Try-On (Fabric.js): Allows overlaying a tattoo (ideally with a removed background) onto a body photo or avatar. AI blending for realism is a key component. Basic transform tools for the tattoo.
Avatar Studio: Parametric SVG avatar generation (MVP complete).
Temporary Tattoo Ordering: A mock flow exists, ending in a confirmation page.
UI/UX: Standardized layout, ShadCN components, theme toggle.
Overall Platform Features (Vision vs. Reality): The current application primarily focuses on the design-to-try-on workflow. Most of the broader ARTTOO platform features (Marketplace, Artist Profiles, Payments, CRM, Advanced AR, etc.) are still on the conceptual drawing board. The background removal uses Genkit's image generation capabilities, not an external specialized API like remove.bg yet.
The Path to a "Comprehensive Editor" Experience:

To elevate the Design Studio from "rudimentary" to "comprehensive and smooth," we need to systematically enhance its core capabilities. The next major strategic thrusts should focus on:

Precision and Layout Control: This is paramount for any serious design tool.
Current: Basic grid, initial snapping.
Needed: Robust and customizable grid, dynamic rulers, advanced snapping (to objects, centers, edges, smart guides), and potentially layout guides.
Advanced Vector Drawing & Editing Tools: Moving beyond basic shapes and freehand pen.
Current: Simple pen, line, polygon.
Needed: Bezier curve tool, path manipulation (editing anchor points, converting shapes to paths, combining/subtracting paths), more brush types and controls.
Sophisticated Layer Management & Effects: Offering more control over composition and appearance.
Current: Basic layer ordering, opacity.
Needed: Layer blending modes, layer masks, non-destructive effects per layer (beyond basic image filters), layer grouping in the panel.
Refined Selection & Manipulation: Making interaction with objects more intuitive and powerful.
Current: Basic selection, transform panel.
Needed: Marquee selection improvements, direct manipulation handles for more properties (e.g., corner radius on a rect), improved group editing (double-click to edit group contents).
Enhanced UI/UX for Design Workflow:
Needed: Contextual menus, keyboard shortcuts for common actions, better visual feedback for tool states and operations, potentially a more robust properties panel that can handle complex nested properties.
The Immediate Next Logical Step (Continuing from our last valid "proceed"):

The most impactful immediate step, aligning with Precision and Layout Control, is to fully implement and refine the Grid and Snapping System within the Design Studio. This was the task we were embarking on.

Why this first? Without precise control over object placement and alignment, even advanced drawing tools become less effective. A solid foundation in layout is critical before adding more complex vector tools. It directly addresses the "rudimentary" feel by providing expected professional-level assistance.
I will now re-present the changes related to enhancing the grid system and implementing more advanced snapping logic, as this was the point where we left off. This involves updating the store to hold new configuration options and modifying the Design Studio page to use them and implement the snapping behavior.

Here are the changes to enhance the grid and implement object snapping:

function CanvasArea() {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const router = useRouter();
  const canvasContainerRef = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const canvasRef = React.useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const imageUploadInputRef = React.useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const {
    fabricCanvas, setFabricCanvas, activeTool, setActiveTool, artboardSize, setArtboardSize,
    selectedObjects, setSelectedObjects, brushSettings, setBrushSettings,
    addToHistory: stateAddToHistory, undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo,
    isLoading, setIsLoading, zoomLevel, setZoomLevel, triggerForceUpdate,
    isDrawingLine, setIsDrawingLine, lineStartPoint, setLineStartPoint, previewLine, setPreviewLine,
    isDrawingPolygon, setIsDrawingPolygon, currentPolygonPoints, addPolygonPoint, resetPolygonDrawing,
    previewPolygonLine, setPreviewPolygonLine,
    showGrid, snapToGrid, gridSize,
    showGrid, snapToGrid, gridSize, gridColor, setGridColor, snapToObjectEdges, toggleSnapToObjectEdges, snapToObjectCenters, toggleSnapToObjectCenters, toggleGrid, toggleSnapToGrid, setGridSize: storeSetGridSize,
    isEditingFromTryOn, setIsEditingFromTryOn,
  } = useDesignStudioStore();
  const currentAddToHistory = React.useCallback((canvasInstance: FabricCanvas | null) => {
      if (!canvasInstance) return;
      const customProps = useDesignStudioStore.getState().history.length > 0 ? CUSTOM_FABRIC_PROPS_FOR_CLONE : ['id', 'layerName', 'selectable', 'evented', 'visible', 'brushType', 'isGridLine', 'shadow', 'brightnessValue', 'contrastValue', 'saturationValue', 'grayscaleEnabled', 'sepiaEnabled', 'blurValue'];
      const objectsToSave = canvasInstance.toJSON(customProps);
      const objectsToSave = canvasInstance.toJSON(CUSTOM_FABRIC_PROPS_FOR_CLONE);
      objectsToSave.objects = objectsToSave.objects.filter((obj: any) => !obj.isGridLine);
      stateAddToHistory(JSON.stringify(objectsToSave));
      triggerForceUpdate();
  }, [stateAddToHistory, triggerForceUpdate]);
  const applyImageFilters = React.useCallback((imgObj: FabricImage) => {
    if (!fabricCanvas || !imgObj) return;
    imgObj.filters = [];
    if (imgObj.brightnessValue !== undefined && imgObj.brightnessValue !== 100) {
      imgObj.filters.push(new fabric.Image.filters.Brightness({ brightness: (imgObj.brightnessValue - 100) / 100 }));
    }
    if (imgObj.contrastValue !== undefined && imgObj.contrastValue !== 100) {
      imgObj.filters.push(new fabric.Image.filters.Contrast({ contrast: (imgObj.contrastValue - 100) / 100 }));
    }
    if (imgObj.saturationValue !== undefined && imgObj.saturationValue !== 100) {
      imgObj.filters.push(new fabric.Image.filters.Saturation({ saturation: (imgObj.saturationValue - 100) / 100 }));
    }
    if (imgObj.grayscaleEnabled) {
      imgObj.filters.push(new fabric.Image.filters.Grayscale());
    }
    if (imgObj.sepiaEnabled) {
      imgObj.filters.push(new fabric.Image.filters.Sepia());
    }
    if (imgObj.blurValue !== undefined && imgObj.blurValue > 0) {
      imgObj.filters.push(new fabric.Image.filters.Blur({ blur: imgObj.blurValue / 100 }));
    }
    imgObj.applyFilters();
    fabricCanvas.renderAll();
  }, [fabricCanvas]);
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!canvasRef.current) return;
    const customProps = useDesignStudioStore.getState().history.length > 0 ? CUSTOM_FABRIC_PROPS_FOR_CLONE : ['id', 'layerName', 'selectable', 'evented', 'visible', 'brushType', 'isGridLine', 'shadow', 'brightnessValue', 'contrastValue', 'saturationValue', 'grayscaleEnabled', 'sepiaEnabled', 'blurValue'];
    const canvasInstance = new fabric.Canvas(canvasRef.current, {
      width: artboardSize.width,
      height: artboardSize.height,
      backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
      preserveObjectStacking: true,
      selectionColor: 'rgba(100, 100, 255, 0.3)',
      selectionBorderColor: 'rgba(100, 100, 255, 0.7)',
      selectionLineWidth: 1,
      stopContextMenu: true,
    }) as FabricCanvas;
    setFabricCanvas(canvasInstance);
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        const imageToLoad = sessionStorage.getItem(SESSION_STORAGE_IMAGE_TO_STUDIO_KEY);
        if (imageToLoad) {
            fabric.Image.fromURL(imageToLoad, (img) => {
                const fabricImg = img as FabricImage;
                fabricImg.set({
                    left: canvasInstance.getCenter().left - (fabricImg.width || 100) / 2,
                    top: canvasInstance.getCenter().top - (fabricImg.height || 100) / 2,
                    id: Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2),
                    layerName: "Imported Tattoo",
                    visible: true,
                    brightnessValue: 100, contrastValue: 100, saturationValue: 100,
                    grayscaleEnabled: false, sepiaEnabled: false, blurValue: 0,
                });
                const maxDim = Math.min(artboardSize.width, artboardSize.height) * 0.8;
                if (fabricImg.width && fabricImg.height) {
                   fabricImg.scaleToWidth(Math.min(fabricImg.width, maxDim));
                   if (fabricImg.getScaledHeight() > maxDim) {
                      fabricImg.scaleToHeight(Math.min(fabricImg.getScaledHeight(), maxDim));
                   }
                }
                canvasInstance.add(fabricImg);
                applyImageFilters(fabricImg);
                canvasInstance.setActiveObject(fabricImg);
                canvasInstance.renderAll();
                currentAddToHistory(canvasInstance);
                setIsEditingFromTryOn(true);
                toast({ title: "Image Loaded from Try-On", description: "Edit the design and send it back when ready."});
            }, { crossOrigin: 'anonymous' });
            sessionStorage.removeItem(SESSION_STORAGE_IMAGE_TO_STUDIO_KEY);
        }
    }
    const handleSelection = (e: fabric.IEvent) => {
      setSelectedObjects(canvasInstance.getActiveObjects().filter(obj => !(obj as FabricObject).isGridLine) as FabricObject[]);
      if (canvasInstance.getActiveObjects().length > 0 && useDesignStudioStore.getState().activeTool !== 'Select') {
        setActiveTool('Select');
      }
      triggerForceUpdate();
    };
    const handleSelectionCleared = (e: fabric.IEvent) => {
        if (e.deselected && e.deselected.some(obj => (obj as FabricObject).isGridLine)) {
            const activeBeforeGridClick = selectedObjects;
            if (activeBeforeGridClick.length > 0) {
                canvasInstance.setActiveObject(new fabric.ActiveSelection(activeBeforeGridClick, { canvas: canvasInstance }));
                canvasInstance.renderAll();
                return;
            }
        }
        setSelectedObjects([]);
        triggerForceUpdate();
    };
    const handleObjectModified = (e: fabric.IEvent) => {
      if (e.target && !(e.target as FabricObject).isGridLine) {
         currentAddToHistory(canvasInstance);
         triggerForceUpdate();
      }
    };
    const handlePathCreated = (e: fabric.IEvent & { path?: fabric.Path }) => {
      if (e.path) {
        const currentBrushSettings = useDesignStudioStore.getState().brushSettings;
        e.path.set({
            stroke: new fabric.Color(currentBrushSettings.color).setAlpha(currentBrushSettings.opacity).toRgba(),
        });
        (e.path as FabricObject).id = Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2);
        (e.path as FabricObject).layerName = 'Drawing';
